title: The Sceptre Deception/Quotes
summary:
"If you can, capture some of them alive for my experiments." 
 - Klaus to his Suits

"I am here to take the story of you annoying the Organization and put a happy ending on it." 
 - Klaus to Dante Vale

"Foolish men! Invoke more Titans!" 
 - Unnamed Suit 030 to his men

"Newsflash - Springer's not a flying squirrel." 
 - Zhalia Moon to Lok Lambert
